# GENERATED by tools/gen_global_power.py - edit the generator, not this file.

# ===========================================================================
# POWER SCORE (country scope)
# ===========================================================================
wif_gp_calc_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { s = num_of_military_factories }
	multiply_temp_variable = { s = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = num_of_civilian_factories }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { s = t }
	set_temp_variable = { t = num_of_naval_factories }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { s = t }
	set_temp_variable = { t = num_divisions }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 200 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { s = t }
	set_temp_variable = { t = num_of_nukes }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 60 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { s = t }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_subf = 0 }
	every_subject_country = {
		add_to_variable = { PREV.wif_gp_subf = num_of_factories }
	}
	multiply_variable = { wif_gp_subf = 0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { s = wif_gp_subf }
	if = { limit = { has_tech = nukes } add_to_temp_variable = { s = 50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_tech = thermonuclear_bombs } add_to_temp_variable = { s = 50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_tech = advanced_large_airframe } add_to_temp_variable = { s = 20 } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_rockets_long_range_ballistic_missile }
		add_to_temp_variable = { s = 50 }
	}
	# Space race and other milestones (tools/gen_space_race.py).
	add_to_temp_variable = { s = wif_gp_bonus_score }

	# Low stability: up to -30%. Surrender progress: up to -50%. Lost capital: -25%.
	set_temp_variable = { m = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_stability < 0.5 }
		set_temp_variable = { k = stability }
		multiply_temp_variable = { k = 0.6 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { k = 0.7 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { m = k }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { k = surrender_progress }
	multiply_temp_variable = { k = -0.5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { k = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { m = k }
	if = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = PREV } } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { m = 0.75 }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { s = m }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_score = s }
}

# ===========================================================================
# MONTHLY GLOBAL PASS - run once a month from whichever country's on_monthly
# arrives first (see the lock in wif_gp_on_actions.txt).
# ===========================================================================
wif_gp_monthly = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_regions_done } } wif_gp_init_regions = yes }
	wif_gp_rank_countries = yes
	wif_gp_update_patrons = yes
	wif_gp_influence_tick = yes
	wif_gp_civil_war_sponsors = yes
	wif_gp_global_upkeep = yes
	wif_gp_defend_checks = yes
	wif_gp_proxy_war_spawn = yes
	wif_gp_nam_upkeep = yes
	wif_gp_prestige_races = yes
	wif_gp_proliferation = yes
}

wif_gp_rank_countries = {
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_top = 1 }
	every_country = {
		wif_gp_calc_score = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_top } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_top = wif_gp_score }
		}
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_pick
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadow_now
		set_variable = { wif_gp_fac_picks = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_great_min = global.wif_gp_top }
	multiply_variable = { global.wif_gp_great_min = 0.25 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.wif_gp_great_min < 150 } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_great_min = 150 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_reg_min = global.wif_gp_top }
	multiply_variable = { global.wif_gp_reg_min = 0.06 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.wif_gp_reg_min < 40 } }
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_reg_min = 40 }
	}

	# Four rounds: the strongest eligible country whose faction has room.
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_global = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick }
			wif_gp_faction_has_room = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_best_score } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = wif_gp_score }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best = THIS }
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		var:global.wif_gp_best = {
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_pick
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						is_faction_leader = yes
						OR = {
							tag = PREV
							is_in_faction_with = PREV
						}
					}
					add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fac_picks = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_global = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick }
			wif_gp_faction_has_room = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_best_score } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = wif_gp_score }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best = THIS }
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		var:global.wif_gp_best = {
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_pick
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						is_faction_leader = yes
						OR = {
							tag = PREV
							is_in_faction_with = PREV
						}
					}
					add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fac_picks = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_global = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick }
			wif_gp_faction_has_room = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_best_score } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = wif_gp_score }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best = THIS }
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		var:global.wif_gp_best = {
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_pick
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						is_faction_leader = yes
						OR = {
							tag = PREV
							is_in_faction_with = PREV
						}
					}
					add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fac_picks = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_global = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick }
			wif_gp_faction_has_room = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_best_score } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = wif_gp_score }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best = THIS }
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		var:global.wif_gp_best = {
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_pick
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						is_faction_leader = yes
						OR = {
							tag = PREV
							is_in_faction_with = PREV
						}
					}
					add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fac_picks = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Eligible, but two stronger Global Powers already stand in its faction.
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_global = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick }
			wif_gp_faction_has_room = no
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadow_now
	}

	# Global Power hysteresis: 3 months in, 6 months out, instant on losing
	# eligibility or being overshadowed.
	every_country = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick }
			add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cand_months = 1 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { wif_gp_cand_months = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { wif_gp_is_global = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_out_months = 0 }
			}
			else = { add_to_variable = { wif_gp_out_months = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadow_now }
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadowed
				wif_gp_demote_global = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						wif_gp_eligible_global = no
						check_variable = { wif_gp_out_months > 5 }
					}
				}
				wif_gp_demote_global = yes
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { wif_gp_is_global = yes }
			has_country_flag = wif_gp_pick
			check_variable = { wif_gp_cand_months > 2 }
			check_variable = { global.wif_gp_global_count < 4 }
		}
		wif_gp_promote_global = yes
	}

	# Growing Superpowers: three rounds over the eligible non-Globals.
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_growing = yes
			NOT = { wif_gp_is_global = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_best_score } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = wif_gp_score }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best = THIS }
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		var:global.wif_gp_best = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_growing = yes
			NOT = { wif_gp_is_global = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_best_score } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = wif_gp_score }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best = THIS }
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		var:global.wif_gp_best = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
	}
	set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_eligible_growing = yes
			NOT = { wif_gp_is_global = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > global.wif_gp_best_score } }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best_score = wif_gp_score }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_best = THIS }
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_best_found
		var:global.wif_gp_best = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
	}
	every_country = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
			add_to_variable = { wif_gp_gcand_months = 1 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { wif_gp_gcand_months = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_growing }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_gout_months = 0 }
			}
			else = { add_to_variable = { wif_gp_gout_months = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						wif_gp_is_global = yes
						wif_gp_eligible_growing = no
						check_variable = { wif_gp_gout_months > 5 }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = wif_gp_growing
				subtract_from_variable = { global.wif_gp_growing_count = 1 }
				log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] is no longer a Growing Superpower"
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_growing }
			NOT = { wif_gp_is_global = yes }
			has_country_flag = wif_gp_gpick
			check_variable = { wif_gp_gcand_months > 2 }
			check_variable = { global.wif_gp_growing_count < 3 }
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_gp_growing
		add_to_variable = { global.wif_gp_growing_count = 1 }
		set_variable = { wif_gp_gout_months = 0 }
		country_event = { id = wif_gp.7 }
		log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] became a Growing Superpower"
	}

	# Everyone's tier and spirit.
	every_country = {
		if = {
			limit = { wif_gp_is_global = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_growing }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score < global.wif_gp_great_min } }
			}
			set_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score < global.wif_gp_reg_min } } }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 1 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 0 } }
		wif_gp_apply_tier_idea = yes

		# Overshadowed lasts while the reason does.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadowed
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadow_now }
			}
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadowed
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadowed NOT = { has_idea = wif_gp_overshadowed_idea } }
			add_ideas = wif_gp_overshadowed_idea
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadowed } has_idea = wif_gp_overshadowed_idea }
			remove_ideas = wif_gp_overshadowed_idea
		}

		# Nuclear Ambition: once the Atomic Age has begun, every Great Power and
		# up chases the bomb, the bomber and the missile.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_gp_atomic_age
				check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 1 }
			}
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_nuclear_ambition
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = wif_gp_nuclear_ambition }
	}
}

wif_gp_apply_tier_idea = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 4 } NOT = { has_idea = wif_gp_tier_global } }
		add_ideas = wif_gp_tier_global
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 4 } } has_idea = wif_gp_tier_global }
		remove_ideas = wif_gp_tier_global
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 3 } NOT = { has_idea = wif_gp_tier_growing } }
		add_ideas = wif_gp_tier_growing
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 3 } } has_idea = wif_gp_tier_growing }
		remove_ideas = wif_gp_tier_growing
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 } NOT = { has_idea = wif_gp_tier_great } }
		add_ideas = wif_gp_tier_great
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 } } has_idea = wif_gp_tier_great }
		remove_ideas = wif_gp_tier_great
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 1 } NOT = { has_idea = wif_gp_tier_regional } }
		add_ideas = wif_gp_tier_regional
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 1 } } has_idea = wif_gp_tier_regional }
		remove_ideas = wif_gp_tier_regional
	}
}

# THIS becomes a Global Power and takes the first free slot.
wif_gp_promote_global = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used } }
		set_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_slot_1 = THIS }
		set_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used } }
		set_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_slot_2 = THIS }
		set_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used } }
		set_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_slot_3 = THIS }
		set_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used } }
		set_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_slot_4 = THIS }
		set_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 4 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 4 }
	add_to_variable = { global.wif_gp_global_count = 1 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_out_months = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 50 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion = 60 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_claims = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_cg = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_strain
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadowed
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_growing }
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_growing
		subtract_from_variable = { global.wif_gp_growing_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_gp_commitments } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_gp_commitments }
	}
	wif_gp_apply_tier_idea = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_atomic_age } }
		set_global_flag = wif_gp_atomic_age
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_n1 = THIS } news_event = { id = wif_gp.1 days = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_n2 = THIS } news_event = { id = wif_gp.2 days = 1 }
	}
	wif_gp_choose_rival = yes
	log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] became a Global Power (score [?This.wif_gp_score])"
}

# THIS stops being a Global Power. wif_gp_overshadowed set = faction rule.
wif_gp_demote_global = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 1 } }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used
		clear_variable = global.wif_gp_slot_1
		every_country = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_fav_1 = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_1
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 2 } }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used
		clear_variable = global.wif_gp_slot_2
		every_country = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_fav_2 = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_2
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_2
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 3 } }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used
		clear_variable = global.wif_gp_slot_3
		every_country = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_fav_3 = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_3
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_3
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 4 } }
		clr_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used
		clear_variable = global.wif_gp_slot_4
		every_country = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_fav_4 = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_4
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_4
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_western_europe
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_central_europe
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_nordic
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_balkans
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_eastern_europe
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_middle_east
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_north_africa
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_africa
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_south_asia
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_central_asia
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_siberia
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_east_asia
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_southeast_asia
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_oceania
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_north_america
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_latin_america
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_south_america
	set_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_claims = 0 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.wif_gp_global_count = 1 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_cand_months = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_strain
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis
	clear_variable = wif_gp_rival
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_gp_commitments } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_gp_commitments }
	}
	wif_gp_apply_tier_idea = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_overshadowed }
		country_event = { id = wif_gp.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = yes }
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_n4 = THIS } news_event = { id = wif_gp.4 days = 1 }
		country_event = { id = wif_gp.3 days = 2 }
	}
	log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] is no longer a Global Power"
}

# ===========================================================================
# RIVAL (Global Power scope). Pool: other Global Powers, else Growing
# Superpowers, else Great Powers. Never a faction mate or a subject.
# ===========================================================================
wif_gp_choose_rival = {
	set_variable = { wif_gp_pool = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 3 }
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = PREV }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { wif_gp_pool = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				NOT = { tag = PREV }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 4 }
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = PREV }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { wif_gp_pool = 4 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_gp_rw_best = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_found
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { tag = PREV }
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { is_in_faction_with = PREV }
			check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = PREV.wif_gp_pool }
		}
		set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 25 }
		if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = democratic } has_government = communism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = democratic } has_government = fascism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = democratic } has_government = democratic }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = democratic } has_government = neutrality }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = fascism } has_government = communism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 80 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = fascism } has_government = democratic }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 40 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = fascism } has_government = fascism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = fascism } has_government = neutrality }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = communism } has_government = fascism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = communism } has_government = democratic }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = communism } has_government = communism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = communism } has_government = neutrality }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = neutrality } has_government = communism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 25 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = neutrality } has_government = fascism }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 25 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = neutrality } has_government = democratic }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 25 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { PREV = { has_government = neutrality } has_government = neutrality }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 25 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_neighbor_of = PREV } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 20 } }
		set_temp_variable = { strong = global.wif_gp_top }
		multiply_temp_variable = { strong = 0.9 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > strong } } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_current_rival_tmp } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_rw = 25 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_rw > PREV.wif_gp_rw_best } }
			PREV = {
				set_variable = { wif_gp_rw_best = PREV.wif_gp_rw }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_rival_new = PREV }
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_found
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_found }
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_found
		# The AI antagonises its rival - once per rival, removed on a change.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = wif_gp_rival }
			var:wif_gp_rival = {
				if = {
					limit = { PREV = { is_ai = yes has_country_flag = wif_gp_ai_rival_set } }
					PREV = { add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = PREV value = -60 } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { wif_gp_rival = wif_gp_rival_new }
		var:wif_gp_rival = {
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = yes }
					add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = PREV value = 60 }
					set_country_flag = wif_gp_ai_rival_set
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 1 } }
			every_country = { clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_1 }
			var:wif_gp_rival = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 2 } }
			every_country = { clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_2 }
			var:wif_gp_rival = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 3 } }
			every_country = { clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_3 }
			var:wif_gp_rival = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_slot = 4 } }
			every_country = { clr_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_4 }
			var:wif_gp_rival = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_government = communism
				var:wif_gp_rival = { has_government = communism }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_sino_soviet_split }
			}
			set_global_flag = wif_gp_sino_soviet_split
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_n6 = THIS } news_event = { id = wif_gp.6 days = 1 }
		}
		country_event = { id = wif_gp.10 days = 1 }
		log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] chose [?This.wif_gp_rival.GetName] as its rival"
	}
}

# ===========================================================================
# PATRONS: subject > faction member of a Global Power leader > client (60+
# influence). Losing a member costs the old patron credibility.
# ===========================================================================
wif_gp_update_patrons = {
	every_country = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_prev_patron = wif_gp_patron }
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_had_patron
		}
		else = { clr_country_flag = wif_gp_had_patron }
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
		clear_variable = wif_gp_patron
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = {
			every_subject_country = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron } }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_in_faction_with = PREV
						NOT = { tag = PREV }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
						NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 2 } }
					}
					set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
					set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 59 }
				wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
			}
			set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_1 }
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = {
			every_subject_country = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron } }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_in_faction_with = PREV
						NOT = { tag = PREV }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
						NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 2 } }
					}
					set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
					set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 59 }
				wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
			}
			set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_2 }
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = {
			every_subject_country = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron } }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_in_faction_with = PREV
						NOT = { tag = PREV }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
						NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 2 } }
					}
					set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
					set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 59 }
				wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
			}
			set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_3 }
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = {
			every_subject_country = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron } }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_in_faction_with = PREV
						NOT = { tag = PREV }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
						NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 2 } }
					}
					set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = PREV }
					set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 59 }
				wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
			}
			set_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_4 }
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
		}
	}
	# Lost members: the old patron, if still a Global Power, pays for it.
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_gp_had_patron
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_defected }
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron }
				NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = wif_gp_prev_patron } }
			}
		}
		var:wif_gp_prev_patron = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes wif_gp_is_global = yes }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = -8 }
				clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_cred min = 0 max = 100 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_target = PREV }
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = wif_gp.46 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ===========================================================================
# INFLUENCE (monthly, target scope)
# ===========================================================================
wif_gp_influence_tick = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_1
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 0 }
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_2
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 0 }
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_3
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 0 }
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_4
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 0 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_1 }
				set_temp_variable = { g = 4 }
				if = { limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 } } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_1 = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 1.25 } }
				# A rival's sphere in crisis is cheap to work on.
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
						NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_1 } }
						var:wif_gp_patron = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis }
					}
					multiply_temp_variable = { g = 2 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 = g }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fav_1 = 1 }
			}
			# Decay: faster in the Non-Aligned Movement and for a patron in crisis.
			set_temp_variable = { dc = 1 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes } set_temp_variable = { dc = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { dc = 2 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 = dc }
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_fav_1 = 0.5 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_inf_1 min = 0 max = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_fav_1 min = 0 max = 100 }

			# Ideology drift.
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.01 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 29 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.02 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 59 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.03 } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = democratic } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = fascism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = communism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = neutrality } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = dp }
				}

			}

			# Government change at 40+ once the ideology leads (AI targets flip, a
			# human target is asked at most every 180 days).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 39 }
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_1 = no
					wif_gp_slot_1_pop_over_45 = yes
					has_war = no
					has_civil_war = no
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = democratic } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = fascism } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = communism } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = neutrality } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
					}

					var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 2 } }
					log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] changed government under slot-1 influence"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = global.wif_gp_slot_1 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_slot = 1 }
					country_event = { id = wif_gp.20 }
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_2 }
				set_temp_variable = { g = 4 }
				if = { limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 } } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_2 = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 1.25 } }
				# A rival's sphere in crisis is cheap to work on.
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
						NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_2 } }
						var:wif_gp_patron = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis }
					}
					multiply_temp_variable = { g = 2 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 = g }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fav_2 = 1 }
			}
			# Decay: faster in the Non-Aligned Movement and for a patron in crisis.
			set_temp_variable = { dc = 1 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes } set_temp_variable = { dc = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { dc = 2 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 = dc }
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_fav_2 = 0.5 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_inf_2 min = 0 max = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_fav_2 min = 0 max = 100 }

			# Ideology drift.
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.01 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 29 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.02 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 59 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.03 } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = democratic } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = fascism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = communism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = neutrality } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = dp }
				}

			}

			# Government change at 40+ once the ideology leads (AI targets flip, a
			# human target is asked at most every 180 days).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 39 }
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_2 = no
					wif_gp_slot_2_pop_over_45 = yes
					has_war = no
					has_civil_war = no
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = democratic } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = fascism } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = communism } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_government = neutrality } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
					}

					var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 2 } }
					log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] changed government under slot-2 influence"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = global.wif_gp_slot_2 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_slot = 2 }
					country_event = { id = wif_gp.20 }
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_3 }
				set_temp_variable = { g = 4 }
				if = { limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 } } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_3 = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 1.25 } }
				# A rival's sphere in crisis is cheap to work on.
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
						NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_3 } }
						var:wif_gp_patron = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis }
					}
					multiply_temp_variable = { g = 2 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 = g }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fav_3 = 1 }
			}
			# Decay: faster in the Non-Aligned Movement and for a patron in crisis.
			set_temp_variable = { dc = 1 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes } set_temp_variable = { dc = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { dc = 2 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 = dc }
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_fav_3 = 0.5 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_inf_3 min = 0 max = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_fav_3 min = 0 max = 100 }

			# Ideology drift.
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.01 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 29 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.02 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 59 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.03 } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = democratic } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = fascism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = communism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = neutrality } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = dp }
				}

			}

			# Government change at 40+ once the ideology leads (AI targets flip, a
			# human target is asked at most every 180 days).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 39 }
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_3 = no
					wif_gp_slot_3_pop_over_45 = yes
					has_war = no
					has_civil_war = no
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = democratic } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = fascism } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = communism } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { has_government = neutrality } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
					}

					var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 2 } }
					log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] changed government under slot-3 influence"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = global.wif_gp_slot_3 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_slot = 3 }
					country_event = { id = wif_gp.20 }
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_camp_4 }

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 2 } } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_4 = yes } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 1.25 } }
				# A rival's sphere in crisis is cheap to work on.
				if = {
					limit = {

						var:wif_gp_patron = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis }
					}
					multiply_temp_variable = { g = 2 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 = g }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_fav_4 = 1 }
			}
			# Decay: faster in the Non-Aligned Movement and for a patron in crisis.
			set_temp_variable = { dc = 1 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes } set_temp_variable = { dc = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { dc = 2 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 = dc }
			subtract_from_variable = { wif_gp_fav_4 = 0.5 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_inf_4 min = 0 max = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_fav_4 min = 0 max = 100 }

			# Ideology drift.
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.01 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 29 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.02 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 59 } } set_temp_variable = { dp = 0.03 } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_government = democratic } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = democratic popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_government = fascism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = fascism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_government = communism } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = communism popularity = dp }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_government = neutrality } }
					add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = dp }
				}

			}

			# Government change at 40+ once the ideology leads (AI targets flip, a
			# human target is asked at most every 180 days).
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 39 }
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_4 = no
					wif_gp_slot_4_pop_over_45 = yes
					has_war = no
					has_civil_war = no
				}
				if = {

					if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_government = democratic } }

					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_government = communism } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { has_government = neutrality } }
						set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
					}

					var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 2 } }
					log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] changed government under slot-4 influence"
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd } }
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_gov_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = global.wif_gp_slot_4 }
					set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_slot = 4 }
					country_event = { id = wif_gp.20 }
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				wif_gp_join_ready_1 = yes
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_2 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_2 > wif_gp_fav_1 } } }
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_3 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_3 > wif_gp_fav_1 } } }
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_4 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_4 > wif_gp_fav_1 } } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				wif_gp_join_slot_1 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_join_offer_cd } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_join_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = global.wif_gp_slot_1 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_slot = 1 }
				country_event = { id = wif_gp.21 }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				wif_gp_join_ready_2 = yes
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_1 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_1 > wif_gp_fav_2 } } }
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_3 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_3 > wif_gp_fav_2 } } }
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_4 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_4 > wif_gp_fav_2 } } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				wif_gp_join_slot_2 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_join_offer_cd } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_join_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = global.wif_gp_slot_2 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_slot = 2 }
				country_event = { id = wif_gp.21 }

			limit = {

				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_2 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_2 > wif_gp_fav_3 } } }
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_4 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_4 > wif_gp_fav_3 } } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				wif_gp_join_slot_3 = yes
			}

				wif_gp_join_ready_4 = yes
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_1 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_1 > wif_gp_fav_4 } } }
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_2 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_2 > wif_gp_fav_4 } } }
				NOT = { AND = { wif_gp_join_ready_3 = yes check_variable = { wif_gp_fav_3 > wif_gp_fav_4 } } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				wif_gp_join_slot_4 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_join_offer_cd } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_join_offer_cd value = 1 days = 180 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = global.wif_gp_slot_4 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_slot = 4 }
				country_event = { id = wif_gp.21 }
			}
		}

		# Contest between slot 1 and slot 2.
		if = {
			limit = {
				wif_gp_slots_1_2_differ = yes
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 24 }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 24 }
				wif_gp_slot_1_pop_over_30 = yes
				wif_gp_slot_2_pop_over_30 = yes
				has_war = no
				has_civil_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_cd }
			}
			random_list = {
				10 = {
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_cw_cd value = 1 days = 730 }
					if = {
						limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_1 = yes }
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_2 = yes
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_2 = yes }
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_1 = yes
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > wif_gp_inf_2 } }
						wif_gp_set_gov_slot_1 = yes
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_2 = yes
					}
					else = {
						wif_gp_set_gov_slot_2 = yes
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_1 = yes
					}
				}
				90 = { }
			}
		}

		# Contest between slot 1 and slot 3.
		if = {
			limit = {
				wif_gp_slots_1_3_differ = yes
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 24 }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 24 }
				wif_gp_slot_1_pop_over_30 = yes
				wif_gp_slot_3_pop_over_30 = yes

				has_civil_war = no

				wif_gp_slots_3_4_differ = yes
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 24 }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 24 }
				wif_gp_slot_3_pop_over_30 = yes
				wif_gp_slot_4_pop_over_30 = yes
				has_war = no
				has_civil_war = no
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_cd }
			}
			random_list = {
				10 = {
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_cw_cd value = 1 days = 730 }
					if = {
						limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_3 = yes }
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_4 = yes
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_4 = yes }
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_3 = yes
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > wif_gp_inf_4 } }
						wif_gp_set_gov_slot_3 = yes
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_4 = yes
					}
					else = {
						wif_gp_set_gov_slot_4 = yes
						wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_3 = yes
					}
				}
				90 = { }
			}
		}

	}
}

wif_gp_civil_war_for_slot_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = democratic } }
		start_civil_war = { ideology = democratic size = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = fascism } }
		start_civil_war = { ideology = fascism size = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = communism } }
		start_civil_war = { ideology = communism size = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = neutrality } }
		start_civil_war = { ideology = neutrality size = 0.5 }
	}

	log = "WiF GP: contested influence threw [This.GetName] into civil war (slot 1 revolts)"
}
wif_gp_set_gov_slot_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = democratic } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = fascism } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = communism } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_government = neutrality } }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
	}

}
# THIS joins the slot-1 bloc (creating a faction if needed).
wif_gp_join_slot_1 = {
	set_country_flag = wif_gp_joining
	if = {
		limit = { wif_gp_nam_member = yes }
		remove_ideas = wif_gp_nam_member_idea
	}
	var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = no }
			create_faction = wif_gp_bloc_faction
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_joining }
				PREV = { add_to_faction = PREV }
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_faction_leader = yes
					is_in_faction_with = PREV
				}
				every_country = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_joining }
					PREV = { add_to_faction = PREV }
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 5 }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_cred min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_joining
	log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] joined the bloc of slot 1"
}

# ===========================================================================
# CIVIL WARS: every Global Power with influence backs the side of its own
# ideology. AI patrons always send a corps; a human patron is asked. Two
# different patrons on opposite sides of a small country = a proxy war.
# ===========================================================================
wif_gp_civil_war_sponsors = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_handled
			has_civil_war = no
		}
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_handled
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_civil_war = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_handled }
			wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
			any_country = {
				civilwar_target = PREV
				has_war_with = PREV
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_handled
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				civilwar_target = PREV
				has_war_with = PREV
			}
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_handled
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp
			clear_variable = wif_gp_cw_patron
		}
		clear_variable = wif_gp_cw_patron
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 9 }
			}
			# Which side shares the patron's government?
			if = {
				limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_1 = yes }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_1 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_1 = yes
				}
				set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 = PREV.wif_gp_inf_1 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_1 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 9 }
			}
			# Which side shares the patron's government?
			if = {
				limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_2 = yes }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_2 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_2 = yes
				}
				set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 = PREV.wif_gp_inf_2 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_2 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 9 }
			}
			# Which side shares the patron's government?
			if = {
				limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_3 = yes }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_3 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_3 = yes
				}
				set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 = PREV.wif_gp_inf_3 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_3 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used
				check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 9 }
			}
			# Which side shares the patron's government?
			if = {
				limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_4 = yes }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_4 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp
					wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_4 = yes
				}
				set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 = PREV.wif_gp_inf_4 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_4 }
				wif_gp_sponsor_side = yes
			}
		}
		# Two different patrons on opposite sides of a small country.
		if = {
			limit = {
				wif_gp_is_proxy_size = yes
				has_variable = wif_gp_cw_patron
				any_country = {
					has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp
					has_variable = wif_gp_cw_patron
					NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cw_patron = PREV.wif_gp_cw_patron } }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.wif_gp_px_next = 1 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_px_id = global.wif_gp_px_next }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_px_side = 1 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_px_patron = wif_gp_cw_patron }
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_px_main
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_px_civil
			random_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_px_id = global.wif_gp_px_next }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_px_side = 2 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_px_patron = wif_gp_cw_patron }
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_px_main
				set_country_flag = wif_gp_px_civil
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.wif_gp_px_count = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.wif_gp_n51 = THIS } news_event = { id = wif_gp.51 days = 1 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp }
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_cw_rebel_tmp
		}
	}
}

# THIS is a civil-war side; wif_gp_cw_patron is its patron.
wif_gp_sponsor_side = {
	set_variable = { wif_gp_vol_from = wif_gp_cw_patron }
	var:wif_gp_cw_patron = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			PREV = { country_event = { id = wif_gp.27 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_target = PREV }
			country_event = { id = wif_gp.26 }
		}
	}
}

# ===========================================================================
# GLOBAL POWER UPKEEP: credibility drift, cohesion, crisis, claim capacity,
# arms race, overstretched economy, Test of Resolve, yearly rival check.
# ===========================================================================
wif_gp_global_upkeep = {
	# Reset the per-member loyalty used by the defection checks.
	every_country = { set_variable = { wif_gp_loyalty = 50 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { l = 50 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 50 } }
				set_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_inf_1 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_fav_1 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { l = 0.85 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_1 = no } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_secession } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_resentment } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_subsidised } add_to_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = l min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_loyalty = l }
			var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = {
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = PREV.wif_gp_loyalty }
			}
		}
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { wif_gp_upkeep_self = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_1_used }
			wif_gp_defections_slot_1 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_2 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { l = 50 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 50 } }
				set_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_inf_2 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_fav_2 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { l = 0.85 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_2 = no } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_secession } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_resentment } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_subsidised } add_to_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = l min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_loyalty = l }
			var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = {
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = PREV.wif_gp_loyalty }
			}
		}
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { wif_gp_upkeep_self = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_2_used }
			wif_gp_defections_slot_2 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_3 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { l = 50 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 50 } }
				set_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_inf_3 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_fav_3 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { l = 0.85 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_3 = no } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_secession } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_resentment } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_subsidised } add_to_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = l min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_loyalty = l }
			var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = {
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = PREV.wif_gp_loyalty }
			}
		}
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_3 = { wif_gp_upkeep_self = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_3_used }
			wif_gp_defections_slot_3 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = {
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_4 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { l = 50 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 50 } }
				set_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_inf_4 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { l = wif_gp_fav_4 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { l = 0.85 }
			if = { limit = { wif_gp_same_gov_as_slot_4 = no } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_secession } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_resentment } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_subsidised } add_to_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 29 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { l = 15 } }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = l min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { wif_gp_loyalty = l }
			var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = {
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gp_coh_sum = PREV.wif_gp_loyalty }
			}
		}
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_4 = { wif_gp_upkeep_self = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_gp_slot_4_used }
			wif_gp_defections_slot_4 = yes
		}
	}
}

# Global Power scope.
wif_gp_upkeep_self = {
	# Credibility drifts back towards 50.
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cred > 51 } } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = -1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cred < 49 } } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 1 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_cred min = 0 max = 100 }

	# Claim capacity: what the AI thinks it can carry.
	set_variable = { wif_gp_claim_cap = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { half = global.wif_gp_top }
	multiply_temp_variable = { half = 0.5 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > half } } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_claim_cap = 1 } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { half = 1.8 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_score > half } } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_claim_cap = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cred > 69 } } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_claim_cap = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion < 50 } } add_to_variable = { wif_gp_claim_cap = -1 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_claim_cap min = 1 max = 5 }
	set_variable = { wif_gp_claim_cap_gamble = wif_gp_claim_cap }
	add_to_variable = { wif_gp_claim_cap_gamble = 1 }

	# Global Commitments: 2% consumer goods per claimed region.
	set_variable = { wif_gp_cg = wif_gp_claims }
	multiply_variable = { wif_gp_cg = 0.02 }

	# Cohesion target = (average member loyalty + credibility) / 2, minus
	# domestic trouble; it moves at most 5 points a month.
	set_temp_variable = { tgt = wif_gp_cred }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_coh_n > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { avg = wif_gp_coh_sum }
		divide_temp_variable = { avg = wif_gp_coh_n }
		add_to_temp_variable = { tgt = avg }
		divide_temp_variable = { tgt = 2 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_stability < 0.3 } subtract_from_temp_variable = { tgt = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { surrender_progress > 0.2 } subtract_from_temp_variable = { tgt = 20 } }
	if = { limit = { capital_scope = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = PREV } } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { tgt = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_gp_overstretched_idea } subtract_from_temp_variable = { tgt = 10 } }
	set_temp_variable = { over = wif_gp_claims }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { over = wif_gp_claim_cap }
	if = {
		limit = { check_temp_variable = { over > 0 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { over = 10 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { tgt = over }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_reformed } add_to_temp_variable = { tgt = 25 } }
	set_temp_variable = { d = tgt }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { d = wif_gp_cohesion }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = d min = -5 max = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion = d }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_cohesion min = 0 max = 100 }

	# Stages.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion < 10 } }
		log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName]'s sphere has collapsed"
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_n43 = THIS } news_event = { id = wif_gp.43 days = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_subject_of = PREV }
			random_list = {
				25 = { PREV = { end_puppet = PREV } }
				75 = { }
			}
		}
		wif_gp_demote_global = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion < 30 } NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis } }
		set_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis
		set_country_flag = wif_gp_strain
		set_variable = { global.wif_gp_n41 = THIS } news_event = { id = wif_gp.41 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion < 50 } NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_strain } }
		set_country_flag = wif_gp_strain
		country_event = { id = wif_gp.40 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion > 54 }
			has_country_flag = wif_gp_strain
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis }
			add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = 10 }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_gp_sphere_holds_idea days = 180 }
			country_event = { id = wif_gp.42 }
		}
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_strain
		clr_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis
	}

	# Arms race: the rival out-builds us.
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_arms_race
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = wif_gp_rival }
		var:wif_gp_rival = { set_variable = { PREV.wif_gp_rival_mil = num_of_military_factories } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_gp_rival_mil > num_of_military_factories } }
			set_country_flag = wif_gp_arms_race
		}
	}

	# Overstretched Economy: military factories above 1.5x civilian for 24 months.
	set_temp_variable = { civ = num_of_civilian_factories }
	multiply_temp_variable = { civ = 1.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { mil = num_of_military_factories }
	if = {
		limit = { check_temp_variable = { mil > civ } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_gp_overstretch_months = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { wif_gp_overstretch_months = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { wif_gp_overstretch_months > 23 }
			NOT = { has_idea = wif_gp_overstretched_idea }
		}
		add_ideas = wif_gp_overstretched_idea
		country_event = { id = wif_gp.90 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = wif_gp_overstretched_idea
			check_variable = { wif_gp_overstretch_months = 0 }
		}
		remove_ideas = wif_gp_overstretched_idea
	}

	# Yearly rival check (or if the rival is gone or no longer a peer).
	add_to_variable = { wif_gp_rival_months = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { wif_gp_rival_months > 11 }
				NOT = { has_variable = wif_gp_rival }
				var:wif_gp_rival = {
					OR = {
						exists = no
						is_subject = yes
						check_variable = { wif_gp_tier < 2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { wif_gp_rival_months = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = wif_gp_rival }
			var:wif_gp_rival = { set_country_flag = wif_gp_current_rival_tmp }
		}
		wif_gp_choose_rival = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_current_rival_tmp }
			clr_country_flag = wif_gp_current_rival_tmp
		}
	}

	# Test of Resolve: the rival probes one of our smaller sphere members.
	set_country_flag = wif_gp_tor_self
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = wif_gp_rival
			var:wif_gp_rival = { is_ai = yes wif_gp_is_global = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_tor_cd }
			any_country = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				var:wif_gp_patron = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_tor_self }
				wif_gp_is_proxy_size = yes
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			3 = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_tor_cd value = 1 days = 365 }
				set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_power = wif_gp_rival }
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
						wif_gp_is_proxy_size = yes
						var:wif_gp_patron = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_tor_self }
					}
					PREV = { set_variable = { wif_gp_ev_target = PREV } }
				}
				country_event = { id = wif_gp.31 }
			}
			97 = { }
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = wif_gp_tor_self
}

# Crisis defections for slot 1 (target-side checks).
wif_gp_defections_slot_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_crisis } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
				check_variable = { wif_gp_patron = global.wif_gp_slot_1 }
				check_variable = { wif_gp_loyalty < 30 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ch = 10 }
			if = { limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion < 20 } } } set_temp_variable = { ch = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_retreat_shield } } multiply_temp_variable = { ch = 0.5 } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_secession } multiply_temp_variable = { ch = 2 } }
			randomize_temp_variable = roll
			multiply_temp_variable = { roll = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_temp_variable = { roll < ch } }
				wif_gp_defect_from_slot_1 = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

wif_gp_defect_from_slot_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { has_subject = PREV } }
		var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { end_puppet = PREV }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = { is_in_faction_with = PREV } }
		leave_faction = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 = 20 }
	}
	set_country_flag = { flag = wif_gp_defected value = 1 days = 365 }
	var:global.wif_gp_slot_1 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_retreat_shield }
			add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = -5 }
		}
		else = { add_to_variable = { wif_gp_cred = -10 } }
		clamp_variable = { var = wif_gp_cred min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	log = "WiF GP: [This.GetName] defected from the slot-1 sphere"
}

# Crisis defections for slot 2 (target-side checks).

			}
			set_temp_variable = { ch = 10 }
			if = { limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { check_variable = { wif_gp_cohesion < 20 } } } set_temp_variable = { ch = 20 } }
			if = { limit = { var:global.wif_gp_slot_2 = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_retreat_shield } } multiply_temp_variable = { ch = 0.5 } }

	}
}
